title: Radio — static, then a voice
text: "...this is Northgate Rail Yard, repeating. We have a train. We have diesel for one run out of {city}. If you can reach us, come. Cross the river. Don't bring the dead."

title: Radio — a calm woman's voice
text: "This is Ruth at {firehouse9}, Alder Street. We have water and a fence. If you're alive and you're not stupid, come east past the transit depot. Knock twice."

title: Radio — an old recording loop
text: "...St. Agnes evacuation has been suspended. Staff are ordered to shelter in place. Repeat, St. Agnes evacuation has been..." The loop is dated day 4.

title: Radio — a man laughing
text: "Northgate bridge is open for business, friends. Toll's fifty cans or one gun. Ask the river what happens if you don't pay."

title: Radio — a teenager reading a notebook
text: "Weather report for day {day}. Clouds. Probably rain later. Fill your buckets. That's the weather. Stay alive, Harrow."
